entries.name: Drilled Ranks
entries.desc: Pikes and infantry +1 armour; all units +3 morale.

entries.name: Horse Breeding
entries.desc: Cavalry +4 health and +1 attack.

entries.name: Longbow Drill
entries.desc: Archers +1 attack and +3 health.

entries.name: Siegecraft
entries.desc: Unlocks workshop engines (rams, throwers). Siege units +1 attack.

entries.name: Field Medicine
entries.desc: Unlocks healer units. Armies recover 5 percent more health each turn at rest.

entries.name: Drill Banners
entries.desc: Unlocks banner units. All units +3 morale.

entries.name: Forged Plate
entries.desc: Infantry, pikes and cavalry +1 armour.

entries.name: Roads and Ledgers
entries.desc: Supply lines reach one step further; new roads cost 20 percent less.

entries.name: Salt Curing
entries.desc: Out-of-supply attrition -25 percent; grain spoils more slowly.

entries.name: Civil Courts
entries.desc: Every province sheds 1 unrest per turn; conquered provinces settle faster.

entries.name: Commerce Charters
entries.desc: Trade routes +30 percent income; coin +5 percent.

entries.name: Granary Law
entries.desc: Stockpile limit +40; grain +10 percent.

entries.name: Bastions
entries.desc: Every garrison fields stronger walls and one more levy (+1 fortification level).

entries.name: Diplomatic Seals
entries.desc: Other houses weigh your proposals more kindly (+10 to their reckoning).

entries.name: Standing Levies
entries.desc: Recruits cost 15 percent less; unit upkeep -10 percent.

entries.name: Metallurgy
entries.desc: Ore +20 percent.

entries.name: Scriptoria
entries.desc: Ink +25 percent; research can spend one more ink per turn.

entries.name: Cartography
entries.desc: Armies and watchtowers see one province further.

entries.name: Astral Calendars
entries.desc: Research can spend two more ink per turn; ink +15 percent.

entries.name: Resonant Forging
entries.desc: Learned from the silenced Choir Warden. Infantry blades are tuned to ring: every blow also shakes the enemy standing behind its target for 40 percent damage.
